name: Fond Waypoints
description: An encrypted place for the accounts, wishes and contacts your family would need.

fields.label: Your email address
fields.help: The first account created with this email becomes the administrator. Set it before you sign up.

settings.label: Allowed email addresses
settings.help: Separate with commas. Leave empty to let anyone who can reach the site sign up. The administrator's email is always allowed.

settings.label: Mail server
settings.help: Leave the email settings empty and invitations are only written to the log. You can also set email up inside Fond under Admin, which takes priority over these.

settings.label: Mail server port
settings.help: 465 uses a secure connection from the start.

settings.label: Suggested waiting days
settings.help: The waiting period suggested when someone invites a trusted contact (1 to 90 days).

settings.label: Back up automatically
settings.help: What you save under Admin > Scheduled Backups in Fond takes priority.

settings.label: Database version
settings.help: Only change this for a Raspberry Pi 4 or older, which cannot run MongoDB 5 or newer. On an install that already has data, switching versions can stop the database from starting.

insideApp: Email, scheduled backups, log export and metrics can also be set inside Fond, under Admin. What is saved there takes priority over what the Gateway sets.
Fond has no LDAP or single sign-on.

storage.label: Database
storage.help: Your accounts, entries and settings. The most important one.

storage.label: Backups
storage.help: Scheduled backups. Best kept on a different disk from the database.

storage.label: Secrets
storage.help: Keys the app made for itself. Keep them with your backups.

storage.label: App settings file
storage.help: Settings saved under Admin > Logs & Metrics.

storage.label: Log files
storage.help: Records of what the app did.

postInstall: Open Fond, choose Get started, and sign up with the administrator email you entered.
